questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why so many people make fake videos about aliens online
Mysterious flying objects and possible aliens
questions.why: They discuss the Tic Tac videos and whether we are alone in the universe.

questions.q: How does Beth say she would feel if she saw strange objects in the sky?
options: Unsure what she was seeing and a bit scared
Sure that they were aliens from another planet
questions.why: She says she might not believe what she was seeing and would be a bit scared.

options: Navy pilots' film of strange objects in 2004
Videos made by NASA scientists to test cameras
Adverts for a type of sweet
questions.why: Neil says Navy pilots recorded mysterious oval objects on a training flight in 2004.

questions.q: Who is reviewing the Tic Tac videos now?
questions.why: Neil says the videos are being reviewed by US Congress.

questions.q: What does Professor Adam Frank think of the pilots?
options: They are honest and aren't claiming it was aliens
They were confused by bad weather and bright lights
questions.why: He says the pilots aren't lying and “They're not saying they're aliens.”

questions.q: Why does Frank say the pilots' reports can't answer the question scientifically?
options: The pilots were flying too far away
questions.why: He says, “personal testimony. You can't do any science with that.”

questions.q: What did a NASA scientist show about one object in the video?
options: It was flying much faster than any jet ever built
It was only moving at about 40 miles an hour
questions.why: A simple analysis showed it was moving at 40 miles an hour.

questions.q: What does Frank suggest by saying there was “nothing very extra-terrestrial about that”?
options: The object was probably something ordinary, not alien
NASA is hiding the truth about the objects from the public
questions.why: The object that looked very fast was only doing 40 mph – nothing alien about it.
